fact_previews: yogagym is an online yoga service that allows users to access yoga classes anytime, anywhere.
The service offers on-demand video classes for people who cannot or do not want to go to a yoga studio.
Lars Jensen is the creator of yogagym.
yogagym provides two levels of yoga training: beginners and advanced.
Instructors provide advice and explanations in the video sessions to guide users in performing exercises correctly.
